about: Every command is a list of steps; every step is a list of atomic steps. egx.py keeps a ledger of them (egx.py step ...). proof: auto = the script proves it from run.json, the receipts and files; cmd = egx.py records it when that subcommand runs; attest = Claude records what it saw with --proof. scope: run = once per command, stock = once per ticker in the ledger. blocks: verdict = the stock is ⏳ without it; report = no report without it; finish = shown as ✘ in the final summary.

skip_reasons.dropped: the chart script dropped the stock (checked by the script)
skip_reasons.failed-upstream: an earlier atomic step of the same ticker failed twice (checked by the script)
skip_reasons.no-sheet: trade_log_sheet_id is empty in the config (checked by the script)
skip_reasons.sheets-off: the Google Sheets connector is not available (give the tool error as --proof)
skip_reasons.no-drive-folder: drive_folder_id is empty in the config (checked by the script)
skip_reasons.drive-off: the Google Drive connector is not available (give the tool error as --proof)
skip_reasons.no-open-calls: egx.py open says nothing is open (checked by the script)
